text:
Type: striped ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: coastal, contemporary, farmhouse
Materials: glossy reactive-glazed ceramic base, linen-look fabric shade, nickel neck
Colors: creamy white, slate blue, grey
Shape: rounded gourd-shaped base with drippy blue bands, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: fresh, soft, breezy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue and grey textiles; coastal or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Table Lamp, 16"H, White and Blue Stripe
product.description: Hues of blue-crackle highlights upon the white ceramic base of this striking lamp lend a true artisanal flair that blends with a variety of styles and decor. 8.5"W x 8.5"D x 15.5"H White ceramic base with blue decoration; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This colorful ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
